text: Figure A. The reporting rule moves the number further than any model has. One set of masks — the shipped v1.49.1 detector with the region classifier off — scored against the same 26 hand-labelled 512 px tiles from 13 specimens, under six reporting rules. Recall reads between 0.625 and 0.920 and IoU between 0.334 and 0.533; the IoU span of 0.198 is larger than the +0.1753 paired median IoU that switching the region classifier off bought, which is the largest gain any model change has made on this corpus. Tolerance is 0 px except on the two rows that say 2 px. 'Median over specimens' means the median over the 13 specimens of the median over that specimen's tiles; pooling a specimen's pixels first and then taking the median is a different number (recall 0.562 rather than 0.716). Each column is its own median, so F1 is not recoverable from the precision and recall drawn beside it. Provenance: the scored mask is the candidate stage. The application's own pipeline emits a strict superset of it — 17,948 further pixels over the 26 tiles, 5.9% of the scored area, 100% of them pass-2 interior candidates — so these are not quite the application's own numbers.
